name: Shiori
message: "Kirishiki-san... doesn't seem to be here."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm glad her memories are back, but I honestly can't bring myself to be happy about it..."

name: Shiori
message: "She's out looking for Gyaruko-san, right...? For revenge..."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm not really in a position to say this after siccing the little thought-form girl on Yasuda, but... um... I just hope they settle things peacefully..."

name: Shiori
message: "...I guess it's not really my place to worry, since I'm not that close to her. Let's talk about something nicer instead."

name: Shiori
message: "I said earlier that I hadn't really come here much, but I remembered..."

name: Shiori
message: "We used to come here a lot as a family. There's a herb garden over there where you can get herbal tea."

name: Shiori
message: "It really brings me back... Sipping tea with my family, surrounded by the scent of herbs and flowers..."

name: Shiori
message: "Want to know something shocking?"

name: Shiori
message: "Everything I said just now was a lie."

name: Shiori
message: "I've never come here with my family, and I don't even know if there's a herb garden. I just made it up."

name: Shiori
message: "Since we came all this way, I felt like I had to share some kind of memory... so I ended up making one up."

name: Shiori
message: "Right, I don't blame you for staring at me like that... But yeah, I much prefer the scent of meat and grease."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh, there's a yakiniku place my family used to go to a lot... but it's not exactly within walking distance."

name: Shiori
message: "Besides, there's no point going somewhere like that anyway. It's not like we could even share a meal together."

name: Shiori
message: "And if you ate meat right in front of me... I might end up losing myself again..."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, no more silly talk. Let's get going."
